question: How many times has India hosted the ICC Men’s T-20 Cricket World Cup as of 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India has hosted the ICC Men's T-20 Cricket World Cup only once as of 2023.**
 
• India hosted the tournament in **2016**.
 
• The ICC T-20 World Cup is a prestigious international championship in the shortest format of cricket.
 
• India was originally scheduled to host the 2021 edition, but it was moved to the UAE and Oman due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **ICC Men's T-20 Cricket World Cup** was first held in **2007** in South Africa.
 
• It is organized by the **International Cricket Council (ICC)** and is contested by teams from around the world.
 
• The tournament has grown in popularity and is one of the most watched cricket events globally.
 
• India won the inaugural T-20 World Cup in 2007 under the captaincy of **MS Dhoni**.
